title: Medtronic tab initially renders the careportal [refresh problem]
symptom: When importing settings into AAPS 3.0, the pump tab initially renders the old careportal (or some variant thereof). The issue resolves after a second reboot.
fix: Restarting the phone a second time resolves the issue. Other workarounds include reconfiguring the pump or disabling and re-enabling visibility for the Medtronic tab in the Profile builder.
evidence_quote: At this point, if I reboot the phone a second time, the issue resolves itself (a third workaround).
